title: Multi-Lane Crosswalk Multiple-Threat Hazard: NEVER Pass a Vehicle Stopped at a Crosswalk!

no_head_on_same_lane.note: All foreground vehicles face same forward direction; oncoming vehicles are in separate lanes left of double-yellow, no head-on in same lane.

no_rhd_cabin.note: Rear exterior view only of blue sedan left foreground and silver van right foreground; no cabin interior or steering wheel visible.

single_bulb_signal.note: Two pedestrian crossing beacons left and right each show one lit yellow lens with other lenses dark; at most one lit lens per signal.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: View from behind northbound lanes: double-yellow centerline on left of blue car, white edge line/curb on right of silver van; oncoming traffic left of center.

scene_match.note: Shows four-lane avenue mid-block crosswalk with yield-triangles, silver van in right lane and blue sedan in left lane both stopped parallel behind triangles for crossing pedestrian.

result.summary: Both northbound vehicles correctly stopped before yield-triangles for pedestrian; US traffic geometry and zero-text rules satisfied.

teaching_correct.note: Both vehicles stopped behind yield line for pedestrian, demonstrating never pass stopped vehicle at crosswalk; no wrong priority or stop-past-line error.
